title: Lee Kong Chian NUS-Stanford Fellowship on Contemporary Southeast Asia

compensation.value: US$8,000 per month stipend, plus airfare

about: Stanford APARC fellowship for researchers on contemporary Southeast Asia, hosted at Stanford between September 2027 and June 2028, with a US$8,000 monthly stipend. Open to social science and humanities scholars at all career stages; deadline January 25, 2027 (Pacific Time).
requirements: Candidates of all career stages with backgrounds and ongoing positions in the social sciences or humanities
CV, project statement (up to three pages), proposed schedule, published English-language writing sample and three academic referees
Applicants wishing to be hosted at NUS apply through the NUS portal

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "project statement (up to three pages), proposed schedule, published English-language writing sample" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"backgrounds and ongoing positions in the social sciences or humanities" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
